Nora: Quick check-in: customers keep asking for a tight private-deploy "minimal ship" that covers VPC/on-prem installs with deterministic upgrades and clear NetOps handoff. Need a concise checklist.
Diego: Proposal: Minimal v1 = operator (single replica), control-plane egress-only, explicit preserve-egress-ip flag, and an upgrade schedule API. Keep inbound open only for handshake port.
Wei: Agree. Add: offline install doc for air-gapped sites + optional KMS integration. For upgrades, define two lanes: patch (minor in-place) and staged (canary across tenant slices).
Hannah: Launch gates: (a) successful staged upgrade in staging with automated verification, (b) smoke net checks (BGP/peering, DNS TTL, socket-preservation), (c) rollback tested.
Nora: Good. Also include required ports one-pager and a firewall example for NetOps. Diego, can you draft that?
Diego: Will do. Ports: 443 (control), 8443 (handshake), 50051 (gRPC), 10250 (kubelet). Outbound 443 only for opt-in telemetry. I'll attach examples.
Wei: Canary policy: auto-fallback if error-rate delta >2% or p50 latency +150ms for 5m. Make thresholds configurable per-customer. Document CLI flags for scheduling (eg `--upgrade-window=sun:02:00-04:00`).
Hannah: Owners: Diego (net checklist), Wei (canary harness + tests), Nora (product sign-off + customer comms). Ops-bot, please remind us next week to review pilot readiness.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1795659120 UTC.
Nora: Thanks — keep replies short. We want this thread as the canonical minimal spec tracker.
